summary: Iteration 64 — Full backend + frontend testing of SpotYou Activity Feed. All 15/15 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified: activity feed visible for members, hidden for non-members, items have avatar/bold-name/action/relative-time.

minor.issue: Endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication. The frontend correctly restricts display to members, but API itself has no auth enforcement. Low severity since data is non-sensitive.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/spot-you/{id}/activity does not call require_auth — the endpoint returns activity data to unauthenticated users. The frontend correctly gates visibility via isMember state, but consider adding auth or member check in the backend if privacy is a concern.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests used existing pt_demo004 (CrossFit outdoor - Bois de Vincennes) with weekly event_schedule (Sunday 09:00-10:30). user@winek.app is member and going.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Activity feed (fil d'activité) fully implemented and verified in iteration 64. Backend 15/15 tests pass. Frontend: Activity feed section 'ACTIVITÉ RÉCENTE' visible only when isMember=true; hidden when not member; items show avatar (photo or initials), bold first name, action text (vient [jour] / a rejoint la communauté), relative timestamp (à l'instant / il y a Xmin). Two items for pt_demo004: Thomas a rejoint + Thomas vient dimanche. Filter rules verified: only future sessions in 'going' activities, only last-30-days joins.
